script_text: Stop right there, Gemini. Mercury, your ruling planet, is forming a provocative square to Uranus in your 11th House of Social Circles, sparking sudden breakthroughs in how you connect with others. The Sun opposes Neptune in your 5th House of Romance, creating a foggy mirror where illusions about love could deceive you today. If you're single, an unexpected encounter after 3 PM carries electric Air energy—trust your intuition but verify before committing. If taken, watch for miscommunications around finances; Mercury's shadow is stirring hidden tensions in your 2nd House of Resources. Your career gets a jolt when Mars enters your 10th House of Status around noon, favoring bold moves but avoiding reckless promises. The blessing: a surprise message from your past arrives this evening bearing unexpected opportunity. Save this reading—follow for tomorrow's transit breakdown before midnight.
